done_with_evidence: content/g7/defs_g7_sentinels.json: 7 Sentinel types + Sentinel Ammo Bearer for Human A (g7_sent_*) and Human B (g7_b_sent_*); def.sentinel = type key, no_command, sealed_suit, pop 2, train 25-45 s; 7 distinct weapons (g7_sent_carbine / rifle / rotary / breacher / harpoon / arc_smg / pdw); production entries with facility cn_sentinel_barracks only; buildings cn_sentinel_barracks (size 2, garrison 120) and cn_ammo_locker (size 1, s7_locker); rules.g7_sentinels (post caps, zone, defence / shield / emp / anti-nanite mults, regen, sidearm, locker, bearer, mender, arc, plan, own_timeout_s, start.force). All PROVISIONAL. Tests test_seven_types_with_distinct_weapons and test_only_the_barracks_trains_them PASS.

sim/systems/garrison.gd: slots_of reads rules.g7_sentinels.posts first (cn_tower 4, cn_checkpoint 15, cn_sentinel_barracks 120); new only_of / admits (def garrison_only, else rules post_only = sentinel); validate_command and place_inside reject others with 'Only Sentinels can garrison here.'. test_garrison_caps_and_sentinels_only PASS (5th Sentinel in a tower: 'The building is full.'; the entry takes 15).

sim/systems/sentinels7.gd (about 1020 lines, preloads nothing): G6Hooks delegates damage_mult / range_mult (inside the facility zone x0.55, Bulwark x0.70, EMP'd x1.3 and no bonus, disruptor rounds vs Machine x2.4, sidearm damage x0.45 / range x0.75); self-heal (6 s quiet, not suppressed, not EMP'd, faster inside the zone, reseals a punctured suit; EMP drops e.suit); sidearm -> nearest stocked ready-ammo locker -> short reload -> back to the job; Mender heals around itself and takes repair jobs; Arc EMP grenade on a drone / Machine target (Apc7._disable, drones destroyed); Ammo Bearer restock + locker refill + self-refill at the barracks or magazine; starting garrison of 24 (rules.start.force) placed straight onto the job board (entry + 3 tower pairs garrisoned, wall-walk pairs N/E/W, 2 interior loop pairs walking opposite ways, QRF / rest in the barracks); alarm (BaseState7 not secure): nearest threat cached per tick, wall pairs shift to the waypoint nearest it, interior pairs and the QRF engage; 13.9c-12 shared facility job board: plan() every 100 ticks staggered by facility id, jobs entry / post / wall / int / qrf / restock / locker / repair / external, most urgent first, previous holders kept until the 240 s shift changes (always under alarm), else nearest fit unit + duty fatigue, wounded (<35%) rest, leftovers rest; trained units enlist as auto and join the roster; a player order makes the job 'player', back to auto when the order completes or after own_timeout_s (45). Tests PASS: test_self_heal_conditions, test_defence_bonus_inside_not_outside (prints 'inside x0.55 outside x1.00 bulwark(out) x0.70'), test_no_chain_of_command_and_starting_garrison (24 Sentinels, >= 10 garrisoned, patrols move, player order honoured then back on duty), test_sidearm_locker_and_bearer.
not_done_priority_order: 1. 13.9c-13 (new owner note: realism and expert tactical depth, no gimmicks): read every word in docs/G7_REFERENCE.md and fold it into the board and the tactics (cover and firing slits, elevated positions, focus fire on the biggest threat, pull wounded pairs back to the Mender, Bulwarks hold doors, Lancers prioritise walkers / vehicles, Arc drones / Machine links; target priority needs a Combat hook CR to ORCH).

2. 13.9c-12 remaining: exposure (e.cn_exp) and fatigue in the job score; buddy pairs (one reloads while the other covers); patrols that cover camera blind spots, with check-ins at posts; the guard net (targets seen by any Sentinel / tower / camera / wall turret shared with every Sentinel); per-unit stand-to positions on alarm; a test that a trained unit walks out of the barracks and takes a job. Mark fact facility.job_board complete once ENG7 has plugged in.

3. Balance fight test (brief item 5): NOT WRITTEN, no numbers yet. Planned design: arena 60, facility raised with seeded=false, cd_ticks = 100000 on every facility part (towers / turrets silent), 20 Sentinels (6 warden, 3 marksman, 3 gunner, 2 bulwark, 2 lancer, 2 arc, 2 mender) on hold at the staging yard; side-1 attackers spawned at the pad area on attack_move: (a) riflemen + at_gunners at 2x / 3x Sentinel value, (b) m_scout_crawler + m_swarm at 2x / 3x, (c) a_old_tank + a_guided_arty + riflemen; plus (a) with no facility (bonus off). Report survivors / value lost. Warning from a Lanchester estimate: 20 Sentinels (about 8.4k value) against 2x value of riflemen (about 200 men) will probably LOSE on open ground even at x0.55, so expect to tune (cost down to about 300, Gunner splash, defence_mult near 0.4) and / or count the towers and walls as part of 'holds the facility'. Needs ORCH's g6_hooks CR applied first, or there is no bonus in a real fight.
4. Hash twice-same test and 'no facility = no cost' test (no sys_state.sent7; tick returns after one lookup) in tests/test_sent7.gd.
5. tools/pt7_sent7.gd playtest (ORCH registered 'sent7'): Sentinels on the walls, in a tower, at the entry booth, an assault by humans and by the Machine; shots at zoom 1 / 1.75 / 2.5; LOOK at each.
6. Post fact sent7.art_needs (7 types + bearer: silhouettes and weapons). Placeholder art = def.art CN operator sheets + def.art_tint [0.62, 0.78, 0.92]; presentation does not apply the tint yet.
7. Barracks occupants still fire out (def garrison_fire false is not enforced; needs a Combat / garrison skip).
change_requests_sent: board seq 3681, to ORCH, change_request.sent7.wiring: world.gd preload Sentinels7 + SYSTEM_ORDER slot right after Wounds; g6_hooks.gd preload + damage_mult '* Sentinels7.damage_mult(w, src, s, t)', range_mult '* Sentinels7.range_mult(w, src, s)', active(): 'if ss.has("sent7"): m |= G6_RANGE'. Until applied, the system does not tick in matches and the defence bonus / sidearm / anti-nanite effects are inactive (tests call S7.tick by hand).

board seq 3787, to ORCH, change_request.sent7.squad_minus1: command_net.gd squad_leader() first line 'if not e.has("squad") or e.has("s7"): return 0'. squad -1 groups every loose unit, so CommandNet currently gives Sentinels a leader (the test prints the in_chain count, 24, until this is applied).

board seq 3682 (+ answer seq 3692), to FACB7, change_request.sent7.placement: place cn_sentinel_barracks at compound cell [24,3] and 8-12 cn_ammo_locker at manned tower bases, wall-walk stairs and the entry booth, as F.parts.
board seq 3683, to LIFE7, change_request.sent7.wall_guards: drop the animated wall guards in favour of the real Sentinels (e.s7, e.s7_sa).
gotchas: Seeding runs when CnFacility raises any human facility: once the system is in SYSTEM_ORDER, every test / soak / Last Protocol run that raises a facility spawns 24 Sentinels, so facility and LP hashes will move (expected; ORCH re-baselines).
